subject: Syria draft resolutions
notes: Aggregate: of Russia's 19 vetoes cast since 2011, 14 concerned Syria; of China's 9 in the same period, 8 concerned Syria and 1 Venezuela. Every Chinese veto since 2005 has been cast alongside Russia.

subject: Condemning the attempted annexation of four Ukrainian regions
notes: Textbook shape of Chinese hedging: Russia blocks, China declines to spend capital and abstains.

subject: Immediate and sustained ceasefire in Gaza
notes: Joint veto of a US-sponsored text; debated in the General Assembly two weeks later.

subject: Safeguarding international shipping through the Strait of Hormuz
notes: 11 in favour, 2 vetoes, Colombia and Pakistan abstaining. Draft would have demanded Iran cease attacks on shipping and encouraged coordinated naval escorts. Cast hours before a US deadline, five weeks into the Israel/US–Iran war that began 28 February 2026.
